using System;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection;
using Microsoft.Extensions.DependencyInjection.Extensions;
using Microsoft.Extensions.Options;
using Moq;
using Orleans.Configuration;
using Orleans.Hosting;
using Orleans.Providers;
using Orleans.Runtime;
using Orleans.Storage;
using Xunit;

namespace Orleans.Hosting.Tests
{
    public class AdoNetGrainStorageServiceCollectionExtensionsTests
    {
        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_CallsGetRequiredServiceOnServiceProvider()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockOptionsMonitor = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            mockOptionsMonitor.Setup(m => m.Get(It.IsAny<string>())).Returns(new AdoNetGrainStorageOptions());
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(mockOptionsMonitor.Object);

            // Act
            var result = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("test", (Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>)null);

            // Assert
            mockOptionsMonitor.Verify(m => m.Get("test"), Times.Once);
            
            // Verify the validator was registered by resolving it
            var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
            var validators = serviceProvider.GetServices<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.Contains(validators, v => v.GetType().Name == "AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault_RegistersWithDefaultName()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockOptionsMonitor = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            mockOptionsMonitor.Setup(m => m.Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME)).Returns(new AdoNetGrainStorageOptions());
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(mockOptionsMonitor.Object);

            // Act
            var result = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault();

            // Assert
            mockOptionsMonitor.Verify(m => m.Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME), Times.Once);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_WithConfigureOptions_InvokesConfigure()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var configureCalled = false;
            Action<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions> configureOptions = opts => configureCalled = true;
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>().Object);

            // Act
            services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("test", configureOptions);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(configureCalled);
        }
    }
}

            mockOptionsMonitor.Setup(m => m.Get("test")).Returns(new AdoNetGrainStorageOptions());

            mockOptionsMonitor.Verify(m => m.Get("test"), Times.Once);

            var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
            var validators = serviceProvider.GetServices<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.Contains(validators, v => v.GetType().Name == "AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault_RegistersValidatorWithDefaultName()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            var mockOptionsMonitor = new Mock<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>();
            mockOptionsMonitor.Setup(m => m.Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME)).Returns(new AdoNetGrainStorageOptions());
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(mockOptionsMonitor.Object);

            // Act
            var result = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorageAsDefault();

            // Assert
            mockOptionsMonitor.Verify(m => m.Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME), Times.Once);

            var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
            var validators = serviceProvider.GetServices<IConfigurationValidator>();
            Assert.Contains(validators, v => v.GetType().Name == "AdoNetGrainStorageOptionsValidator");
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_SimpleOverload_CallsOptionsBuilderConfigure()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            Action<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions> configureAction = opts => opts.Invariant = "TestInvariant";
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(Mock.Of<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>());

            // Act
            var result = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME, configureAction);

            // Assert - verify by checking configured options
            var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
            var options = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>().Get(ProviderConstants.DEFAULT_STORAGE_PROVIDER_NAME);
            Assert.Equal("TestInvariant", options.Invariant);
        }

        [Fact]
        public void AddAdoNetGrainStorage_OptionsBuilderOverload_CallsProvidedConfigure()
        {
            // Arrange
            var services = new ServiceCollection();
            bool configureCalled = false;
            Action<OptionsBuilder<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>> configure = b =>
            {
                configureCalled = true;
                b.Configure(opts => opts.Invariant = "BuilderTest");
            };
            services.AddSingleton<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>(Mock.Of<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>());

            // Act
            var result = services.AddAdoNetGrainStorage("test", configure);

            // Assert
            Assert.True(configureCalled);
            var serviceProvider = result.BuildServiceProvider();
            var options = serviceProvider.GetRequiredService<IOptionsMonitor<AdoNetGrainStorageOptions>>().Get("test");
            Assert.Equal("BuilderTest", options.Invariant);
        }
    }
}
